summary: Kaniksu NF, Pend Oreille County, WA. 40-foot L-4 pole tower built 1934 on a 1932 tree platform; removed (or destroyed) in 1961.

facts.design: 15-foot tree platform developed in 1932; 40-foot pole tower with L-4 cab built in 1934
facts.status_note: Removed in 1961 per the register and Willhite; firelookout.com says destroyed. No source describes what remains at the site.

events.note: 15-foot tree platform developed at the site
40-foot pole tower with L-4 cab built

evidence.supports: site is about 14 miles east of Ione

evidence.quote: Developed in 1932 with a 15' tree platform, this 40' pole L-4 tower, built in 1934, was removed in 1961.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and Willhite say the tower was removed in 1961; firelookout.com says it was destroyed that year. The story reports both without choosing one.
Register gives 5,330 ft; Willhite gives 5,330 ft on current maps and 5,343 ft on old maps. The story reports both figures.

notes_for_editor: Brief status gone, coordinates, elevation and the 2012 registration all match the sources, so no corrections. Only four short sources; the 1961 fate is disputed (removed vs destroyed). No source states access or what remains today, so access and visit are omitted. firelookout.com credits a Fire Lookout Museum photo but gives no image URL, so no photo was added.
